title: Multi-Agent Orchestration Platform
description: Built omb-agent — a platform orchestrating AI agents via AutoGen and CrewAI, connected to n8n, Dify, and Telegram. Achieved full end-to-end automation of complex multi-step workflows that previously required manual coordination across multiple tools.

title: Infrastructure-as-Code Environment
description: Designed and maintains a complete IaC dev environment with Docker Compose stacks for PostgreSQL, Redis, Qdrant, Traefik, Watchtower, Portainer, and multiple application services — all version-controlled, reproducible, and secured with automated secret rotation.

title: Telegram Bot Automation
description: Developed a Telegram-based scheduler and notification system that bridges messaging with Google Calendar, Google Sheets, and custom data pipelines. Running reliably in production with automated deployment and monitoring.

title: Fitness Data Pipeline
description: Built garmin2googlesheet — an automated ETL pipeline extracting fitness metrics from Garmin Connect and syncing them to structured Google Sheets, enabling custom analytics dashboards and long-term trend tracking.
